spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (लटति)
1 To be a child, to talk or be like one.
2 To speak a little.

m. (-टः)
1 A block head, a fool, one speaking ignorantly or foolishly.
2 Fault, defect.
3 A thief.
E.
लट to be or talk as a child, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-ट्टः)
A vile or bad man, a wretch.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Old or worn, spoiled, shabby, (as clothes, ornaments, &c.)
2 Childish.
m. (-टः)
1 Cloth, clothes.
2 Fault, defect.
3 Idle or inebriate language.
4 Repetition of words in the same sense, but a different application.
5 The name of a country, the upper part of the Dekhin, Lār or Larice.
E.
लट to be childish, aff. घञ्, or लाट Kaṇḍvādi root, to live, aff. अच्, or लट childish, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A vile or contemptible man.
E.
लट to talk as a child, and वुन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ट्वः)
1 A horse.
2 A division of music.
3 A low and wild tribe, a tribe of mountaineers.
f. (-ट्वा)
1 A bird said, to be a kind of sparrow.
2 A fruit, a variety of the

A bad or unchaste woman.
4 Curls on the forehead or hanging down on the face.
5

A Sweetmeat.
E.
लट to be like a child, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.

m. (-सः)
A figure of rhetoric; repetition of a word in the same sense, but with a different application.
E.
लाट, and अनुप्रास alliteration.
